title: timer's invisible armor
description: allows making individual pieces of armor invisible
body:
**Allows making individual pieces of armor invisible.**

So you and your friends can see each other's epic Minecraft skins :)

Unlike minimal armor resource packs, this only applies to pieces of equipment you tell it to, which allows you to still see armor on hostile mobs and also armor stands.

---

**Smithing recipes:**

• Combining a piece of armor with an **amethyst shard** will make it render **invisible** on the player.

• Combining an invisible piece of armor with **glow berries** will make it **visible** again.

---

Optionally, there's also a command that does the same thing.

(but the smithing recipes exist because updates change/break commands on occasion)

 the following commands hide & unhide armor:
---
```
/trigger hide
```
```
/trigger unhide
```


---

**This works for all player armor (head/chest/legs/feet pieces) as well as; horse armor, wolf armor, nautilus armor, and saddles.**

**This also works for most tools and weapons.** Though, there's not really a reason to use it on those things.

---
